programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Rate decision week in focus
programme.desc: The Fed raised rates for the first time in three years, while the Bank of Japan is set to make its move next. With energy prices elevated and inflation pressures persisting, central banks are turning more hawkish. Will tightening continue? And what does it mean for the dollar, yen, renminbi, bond yields, and gold? This week on BizTalk, we take a closer look at the new global rate cycle and its market impact.#BizTalk #BizPodcast

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: China's ocean economy at a turning point
programme.desc: Since elevating the goal of becoming a maritime power in 2012, China has made significant progress. What are the most eye-catching achievements? As the focus shifts from speed to quality, how could China's AI and digital tech edge help reshape the country's traditional maritime sectors? And in a system where a few countries still hold technological and narrative dominance, how can China gain a greater voice in rule-setting through global cooperation?Host TU Yun joins Yan Yan, a senior research fellow with the National Institute for South China Sea Studies, Qu Qiang, a professor and fellow of the Belt and Road Research Center at Minzu University of China, and Warwick Powell, an adjunct...

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN as we reveal how a drop of crude oil transforms into our clothes, uncovering a complex and fascinating journey of the textile and garment manufacturing process. Follow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing's bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We'll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing's mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: China's Extraordinary Hotels 2 - Designing Hotels
programme.desc: The second episode of the Hotel Series features three uniquely styled design hotels: the industrial-style Zhagen Shanyu Hotel in Chongqing, Yisheng Hotel in Wuxi, Jiangsu, and the Naxi-style Shujia Yulu Boutique Hotel in Lijiang, Yunnan. This episode explores not only their surrounding landscapes, design concepts, architectural styles and interior furnishings, but also the distinctive natural scenery and profound local cultural features of each region.

programme.title: In Search of Shunde Ep.1
programme.desc: A Bite of Shunde tells the stories of Shunde locals through food, showcasing this city’s heritage and present-day life. It looks at the craftsmanship Shunde people apply in the kitchen and beyond, and the dedicated, artisan mentality behind their renowned culinary culture. Through their attitude toward a simple home-cooked meal, we get insights into their values and way of life.

programme.title: Blossom China
programme.desc: Every year when the flowers come into full bloom, countless people across China set out for the country’s most popular flower-viewing destinations to enjoy nature’s colorful spectacle, fueling an increasingly vibrant flower-tourism economy. What ecological progress has made this possible, and how is it reshaping local communities? In the 30-minute CGTN special Blossom China, host Liu Qiuyuan, reporter Idah, and host Martin visit the “Train to Spring” at Juyongguan in Beijing, the peony-filled China National Flower Garden and Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, and the breathtaking Baili Azalea Scenic Area in Bijie, Guizhou—sharing the stories behind the blossoms through a unique lens.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the World's Longest Hair Village, to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Blossom China
programme.desc: Every year when the flowers come into full bloom, countless people across China set out for the country’s most popular flower-viewing destinations to enjoy nature’s colorful spectacle, fueling an increasingly vibrant flower-tourism economy. What ecological progress has made this possible, and how is it reshaping local communities? In the 30-minute CGTN special Blossom China, host Liu Qiuyuan, reporter Idah, and host Martin visit the “Train to Spring” at Juyongguan in Beijing, the peony-filled China National Flower Garden and Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, and the breathtaking Baili Azalea Scenic Area in Bijie, Guizhou—sharing the stories behind the blossoms through a unique lens.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the World's Longest Hair Village, to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's influencer hotspots, attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise: Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand.Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the Xiangjiang Ladies who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand.Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4

Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand.Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the Xiangjiang Ladies who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: In Love with Plants
programme.desc: Beijing is home to some 2,300 plant species - that's more than you'd find in the entire UK. Yu Tianyi is a botanical artist who creates scientific and ecological illustrations that portray species accurately and true to life. His hometown of Beijing is itself a haven for biodiversity. Yu's art has drawn attention to the importance of preserving natural landscapes and vegetation, serving as a call to better understand and protect local species.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.title: Clothing woven in the mountains
programme.desc: In Longsheng, southern China, ethnic communities have lived for generations among the same mountains and rivers. The landscape of terraced fields stretches across the valleys, carrying layered cultural memories.In this episode, CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipino singer Eliza Arce travel to Huangluo Yao Village. Beginning with the Red Yao tradition of sun-drying clothes, they explore the colours, craftsmanship, and everyday wisdom woven into these garments. Their journey culminates in a vibrant bonfire gathering, where different communities come together in celebration.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,...

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill.Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Shared Roots in Wrestling
programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Into Guilin's landscapes: A new way to experience rural China
programme.desc: Guilin in south China's Guangxi region has long been celebrated for its breathtaking karst landscapes. Today, more and more travelers are discovering the region in a different way. Instead of simply admiring the scenery, they immerse themselves in it through cycling, hiking, bamboo rafting or via ferrata, experiencing the countryside from a new perspective. Supported by convenient transport links and a thriving outdoor recreation industry, Yangshuo County in Guilin is emerging as a global magnet where nature, culture and local life converge. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they explore Yangshuo through a variety of outdoor adventures.

programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,...

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill.Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.desc: After nearly losing her weapon while catching a dangerous criminal, Rita is taken off active duty to train at a facility in hand to hand combat for female police officers to avoid another dangerous situation. While there, she meets an old friend in the form of Robin Curry, a police officer with the Internal Affairs division of Palm Beach and the two catch up on old times. Robin seemed a little worried about something and tries to tell Rita during dinner but chooses not to. An hour or so later, Robin tries to call Rita up saying that she has to meet with her and so along with Chris, they go on the prowl to find her but are too late when Robin is found in a motel in her lingerie, cuffed and strangled to death. Things get personal for Rita at this point but her problems are just beginning when two officers from Special Investigations start asking sensitive questions about Rita's relationship with Robin, even suggesting that the two may have been lovers. Rita is shocked, appalled and extremely angry at the accusation and even more enraged when they suggest that Robin may have been crooked after $600,000 in evidence money turns up missing. Left high and dry and with no one else to turn to but Chris, Rita goes on a personal mission through the dark underworld of SAndM in an attempt to fight for her rights as a cop and save the reputation of her deceased colleague who may have been murdered because Robin knew the truth behind who really stole the money...and who tried to set her and Rita up.

programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, The Devil's Plateau. What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending Teknival in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written DIRTY RAPIST. Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of a four year old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 18th 2014, in Visé, Belgium, policemen are informed that gunshots had been fired on the street.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A college student was found dead, and the evidence suggested he knew his killer. Three hairs and some microscopic cells helped police to unravel a web of lies, and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on a golf course. The grass on the course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. The killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind - tiny but unmistakable clues which pointed to him and him alone.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer and he'd been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a man is shot down in his garage, police discover that a wound on the widow may have been self-inflicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders. The killer used poison which had no taste.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police hoped the shoe impressions found at a crime scene would put their investigation back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist was on the loose in Washington, DC. Each of the fires was started with the same type of incendiary device. The perpetrator was very careful, and seemed to leave no evidence behind... but there were clues in the ashes, and it was up to forensic scientists to find them.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science gave investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Three homicides on two continents looked like professional executions. Investigators on both sides of the Atlantic needed to find out if they were related and, if they were, who or what they had in common.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A killer tried to incinerate and destroy everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently created new forensic evidence, evidence which came to light with a technique never before used in a criminal investigation.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 13: on December 21, 2013 at the Ariake Coliseum in Tokyo, Japan. The highlight of the event was a Glory Welterweight World Championship Tournament. Two tournament matches were held, with a third match as reserve. The winners of the two semi-final bouts proceeded to the finals for the championship main-event. The event also featured other non-tournament bouts, including the retirement match of the legendary Peter Aerts, against Rico Verhoeven, and Daniel Ghiță vs. Errol Zimmerman II.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 14 Zagreb marked GLORY's return to the airwaves, as well as our return to Europe, and the event exceeded everyone's expectations. We saw the return of Mirko Cro Cop, the retirement of legendary Remy Bonjasky, the crowning of a new Lightweight Champion in spectacular fashion, and the first ever Middleweight Contender Tournament played out in a thrilling one-night tournament.
